tasks.goal: Patrol the river-valley procession circuit along the Gave de Pau riverbank and report progress-marker checkpoints.
tasks.terrain: Gravel and packed-earth riverbank paths, wet cobblestones near the grotto, crowd barriers along procession routes.
success: Complete 3 laps of the perimeter waypoint loop
Localization error < 0.5 m at each checkpoint
No e-stop events during run
Checkpoint arrival timestamps logged at 1 Hz
safety_stops: E-stop if obstacle within 1.0 m
Stop for any pedestrian within 2 m in path
Halt on slope slip > 10 degrees
Weather/wet-surface speed cap at 0.5 m/s
tasks.human_in_loop: Human steward approves patrol route and reviews the progress report before it is filed to the Progress Observatory.

tasks.goal: Carry printed charter documents between the Charter Hall display stands and the visitor information desk.
tasks.terrain: Smooth indoor flagstone floor, low display plinths, queue rails near the desk.
success: 10 successful delivery cycles without dropping payload
Dock-to-desk transit under 90 s per cycle
Obstacle avoidance engaged at least once per lap in a valid way
Battery above 20% at run end
safety_stops: Stop if payload tilt > 15 degrees
Stop for humans within 1.5 m
Return to dock if battery < 20%
E-stop on wheel slip or floor obstacle detection
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms each charter document batch before transport, since charter materials are governance artifacts.

tasks.goal: Inspect labeled research bins and publication shelves, reading QR codes to log evidence summaries received.
tasks.terrain: Lab flooring with cable runs, shelf edges at 0.5-1.5 m height, chair legs at workstations.
success: Read 20/20 QR labels with no misreads
Torso lift reaches all three shelf tiers
Zero collisions with furniture
Inspection log published per bin within 2 s of read
safety_stops: Stop arm/torso if human within 1 m
E-stop on unexpected contact force
Pause if camera feed drops
Do not enter aisles occupied by staff
tasks.human_in_loop: A person reviews flagged or unreadable QR entries before the evidence log is committed.

tasks.goal: Mount proposal boards and placards on forum stands at fixed poses for the debate session.
tasks.terrain: Fixed table-top stands, board weight up to 3 kg, surrounding crowd-barrier posts.
success: Place 6 boards within 1 cm and 3 degrees of target pose
Peak contact wrench < 20 N during placement
No dropped boards
Cycle time under 45 s per board
safety_stops: Stop if wrench exceeds 20 N
Stop if human enters 1.5 m workspace radius
Reduced mode (250 mm/s) when people present
E-stop on trajectory deviation > 5 cm
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies board content and placement before the forum opens; agent never finalizes proposal displays.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude photogrammetry pass over the grotto rock face and riverbank to update the site digital-twin mesh.
tasks.terrain: Uneven rock face of the Massabielle grotto, overhanging vegetation, river mist, variable wind in the valley.
success: Complete 4 horizontal scan lines within 0.2 m of planned altitude
Land with residual velocity < 0.1 m/s
Capture 200+ usable frames with <5% blur
Return-to-home within 0.3 m accuracy
safety_stops: Land immediately if wind gust > 8 m/s
Avoid no-fly volume above grotto interior
Battery < 25% triggers return-to-home
Land if any human within 2 m below flight path
tasks.human_in_loop: Site steward approves flight volume and time window; flights pause during processions.

tasks.goal: Carry water crates from the Operations Deck staging area to working-group stations along the procession ground.
tasks.terrain: Mixed gravel and flagstone ground, slight riverbank slope, crate stacks at staging pallets, pedestrian traffic.
success: Transfer 8 crates with zero drops
Bipedal balance maintained (no foot-slip recovery events)
Mean transfer time < 4 min per crate
Placement within 5 cm of station markers
safety_stops: Stop walking if human within 2 m in path
Squat-place crate if balance margin below threshold
E-stop on foot slip > 10 cm
Do not lift crates over 10 kg rated limit
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward assigns station targets and confirms final crate placement at each working-group station.

tasks.goal: Greet visitors, answer scripted questions about the DAO charter and contribution model, and route complex queries to stewards.
tasks.terrain: Crowded kiosk area with stone floor, stanchions, visitors including elderly and wheelchair users.
success: Correctly answer 90% of 20 scripted charter questions
Detect and face each visitor within 2 s of approach
Zero navigation collisions with stanchions
Log all unanswered queries for steward routing
safety_stops: Stop motion if visitor within 0.8 m
Refuse to state governance decisions; redirect to humans
Pause speech if ambient noise > 80 dB
Shutdown greeting mode if overcrowding detected
tasks.human_in_loop: All charter interpretation beyond scripted FAQ is routed to human stewards; NAO never drafts or decides proposals.

tasks.goal: Sort incoming evidence samples and data drives into labeled trays for the synthesis agents to process.
tasks.terrain: Bench-top workspace with tray dividers, drive enclosures, cable clutter, occasional shared bench use by staff.
success: Sort 30 items into correct trays with zero misplacement
Grip force within 5-15 N band for all items
No self-collision or contact-reflex triggers
Throughput at least 12 items per 10 min
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact force > 15 N
Stop if human hand enters workspace volume
Pause if tray slot occupied unexpectedly
Disable on camera occlusion > 2 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Lab staff approve the tray taxonomy and handle any item flagged as fragile or ambiguous.
